name: Steam Generator (primary side only - secondary deferred)
notes: US EPR FSAR Ch 5.4-derived; numerics approx. SCOPE decided 2026-07-10: primary side only (channel-head plena + tube bundle) so the reactor-SG-RCP-reactor loop is closed. The whole secondary side (shell, level/pressure, FW/EFW nozzles, MSSVs, MSRT, MSIV, blowdown, N16 monitor) is DEFERRED and will be added to this file later - modeled here only as the external:SG{n}-SEC heat sink. Tube bundle lives here (not loop.json) so the SGTR primary-to-secondary coupling stays in one file. MSSVs will be modeled as separate devices (2 per line + 1 MSRT), decided 2026-07-10.

devices.name: SG {n} inlet plenum (hot channel head)
devices.behavior: Hot-side channel head: receives full loop flow from RCS{n}-HL and distributes it into the tube bundle. Divided from the outlet plenum by the partition plate. 'leak' = primary leak inside containment (e.g. manway) - casualty state.

devices.name: SG {n} U-tube bundle
devices.behavior: Inverted U-tube bundle: primary water flows up and back down inside the tubes, boiling secondary water on the shell side. THE primary/secondary boundary. 'leak' = small primary-to-secondary leakage (within tech-spec limits, slow secondary activity rise); 'rupture' = SGTR: one or more tubes severed, primary inventory blows into the secondary at full RCS-to-SG dP. Heat transfer scales with primary flow, primary-secondary dT, and tube condition. Secondary-side detection (N16, activity) arrives with the deferred secondary model.

devices.name: SG {n} outlet plenum (cold channel head)
devices.behavior: Cold-side channel head: collects tube-bundle discharge and delivers it to the crossover leg RCS{n}-XL toward RCP{n} suction.

links.notes: to crossover leg / RCP{n} suction - see rcs/loop.json
secondary side boils off primary heat - DEFERRED, placeholder boundary until the secondary model lands in this file
SGTR leak path: active only in 'leak'/'rupture' states, primary water into the secondary shell

dependencies.interface: loop piping: RCS{n}-HL into inlet plenum, outlet plenum into RCS{n}-XL
secondary side of this same SG: shell heat sink, SGTR receiving volume
dependencies.notes: Deferred - will be absorbed into this file, not a separate system. Until then external:SG{n}-SEC is an ideal heat sink.
